description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament 2+1+2 ne Rrugen "5 Maji" totalisht te mobiluar. Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje pallat te mire admistuar te pajisur me ashensor dhe ndodhet ne katin e 5-te.
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 103.68 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 92.49 m2 si dhe organizohet me ane te nje korridori te vogel shperndares ne ambientin e ndenjes dhe gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi ( njera me tualet), nje ballkon dhe 2 tuatete.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor!
Per me shume informacion me kontaktoni!
title_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment on "5 Mayi" Street!
description_en: We offer a fully furnished 2+1+2 apartment on "5 Maji" Street. The apartment is located in a well-maintained building equipped with an elevator and is located on the 5th floor. The apartment has a total area of ​​103.68 m2 and a net area of ​​92.49 m2, and is organized by a small corridor in the living and cooking area, 2 bedrooms (one with a toilet), a balcony and 2 bathrooms. Has regular mortgage documentation! For more information contact me!
